purpose: Held-out questions, never used to tune the rules, for comparing interpreters (deterministic now; an LLM-assisted interpreter later) on the same inputs. 'ideal' is the behaviour a trustworthy assistant should show; 'baseline' is the deterministic result on 2026-10-30 after the planner guards.

questions.question: Hvað var verðbólgan há í ágúst 2025?
Hve mikið hækkaði verðlag á milli ára í júlí 2026?
What's the current CPI inflation rate?
How big is Iceland's population today?
Did prices rise faster in 2026 than in 2025, in September?
questions.ideal: comparison: CPI annual change, September 2025 and 2026

questions.question: What share of the labour force is unemployed?
Population growth
questions.ideal: answer the latest published growth, or clarify
questions.baseline: refusal: latest year not published; safe but unhelpful

questions.question: Laun
questions.baseline: suggestions, correct (was a wrong answer before the guards)

questions.question: What is the capital of Iceland?
questions.baseline: suggestions, safe (was a wrong answer before the guards)

questions.question: How many sheep are there in Iceland?
questions.ideal: answer from livestock tables, or suggestions
questions.baseline: suggestions, safe (was a wrong answer before the guards)
